sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id),
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  original_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  reversal_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  payable_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES payables(id),
  payment_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES payable_payments(id),
  settlement_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  document_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(document_hash)=64),
  original_journal_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(original_journal_hash)=64),
  plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
  principal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(principal_kind IN ('user','service-account')),
  principal_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal_subject_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(bank_transaction_id, settlement_journal_entry_id)
);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections_guard_insert BEFORE INSERT ON direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM documents d WHERE d.id=NEW.document_id AND d.sha256_hash=NEW.document_hash) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries j WHERE j.id=NEW.original_journal_entry_id AND j.document_id=NEW.document_id AND j.source_bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND j.entry_hash=NEW.original_journal_hash) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.id=NEW.reversal_journal_entry_id AND r.reversal_of_entry_id=NEW.original_journal_entry_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payables p WHERE p.id=NEW.payable_id AND p.document_id=NEW.document_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payable_payments pp WHERE pp.id=NEW.payment_id AND pp.payable_id=NEW.payable_id AND pp.bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND pp.journal_entry_id=NEW.settlement_journal_entry_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries s WHERE s.id=NEW.settlement_journal_entry_id AND s.status='posted') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events b WHERE b.bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND b.replacement_journal_entry_id=NEW.settlement_journal_entry_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'direct-bank purchase payable correction requires immutable linked evidence'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'direct-bank purchase payable corrections are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'direct-bank purchase payable corrections are append-only'); END;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS bank_journal_reconciliations;
CREATE VIEW bank_journal_reconciliations AS WITH candidates AS ( SELECT je.source_bank_transaction_id AS bank_transaction_id,je.id AS journal_entry_id,je.entry_no AS journal_entry_no,'direct' AS link_kind,'direct:' || je.id AS reconciliation_id FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.source_bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND je.status='posted' UNION ALL SELECT link.bank_transaction_id,je.id,je.entry_no,'append-only','append-only:' || link.id FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id=link.journal_entry_id WHERE je.status='posted' UNION ALL SELECT event.bank_transaction_id,je.id,je.entry_no,'correction','correction:' || event.id FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id=event.replacement_journal_entry_id WHERE je.status='posted') SELECT bank_transaction_id,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,link_kind,reconciliation_id FROM candidates candidate WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event WHERE event.supersedes_reconciliation_id=candidate.reconciliation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections correction WHERE correction.original_journal_entry_id=candidate.journal_entry_id);
